title: Monthly forecast — Temperature at 2 Meters (12 months)

methodology.external_basis: FPP3 (Hyndman & Athanasopoulos 2021); Tashman 2000; Lei et al. 2018

uncertainty.method: empirical residual quantiles per horizon from out-of-sample rolling-origin errors
uncertainty.statement: Intervals describe historical out-of-sample error of this statistical model; they are not climate-scenario uncertainty.

assumptions: Monthly statistics are stationary apart from a linear trend over 1981–2025
MERRA-2 reanalysis adequately represents the regional monthly climate
limitations: ~50 km cells: one cell covers all of Bengaluru; no neighbourhood-scale prediction.
Forecast issued from the last ACQUIRED month (Dec 2025); 2026 months already elapsed can be verified once acquired.
Not a weather forecast and not a climate projection.

findings.statement: Temperature at 2 Meters: the selected models beat climatology on held-out 2018–2025 data at horizons 1, 2, 3, 4 month(s) (MAE skill up to 26%). Beyond that, forecasts carry no more information than the monthly climatology.
findings.rule: Skill = 1 − MAE_model/MAE_climatology on test; >2% counted as skill (engineering threshold)

findings.statement: 80% prediction intervals covered 69%–78% of held-out observations across horizons (nominal 80%).

trace.detail: NASA POWER monthly T2M: 25 cells × 540 months (1981-01–2025-12), 0 missing
Record length ≥30 years; fill values already null

Per horizon: lowest calibration MAE (ties → simpler model); h1:damped_persistence, h2:damped_persistence, h3:damped_persistence, h4:damped_persistence, h5:damped_persistence, h6:damped_persistence, h7:damped_persistence, h8:damped_persistence, h9:damped_persistence, h10:climatology, h11:climatology, h12:climatology
Final refit on all data ≤ 2025-12 (6 candidates; ridge/GBM pooled over 25 cells)
